```{r setup}
# ==============================================================================
# Purpose: aggregate PST freshwater salmon angler-trip estimates (2022-2025) to
# the eight HUC4 hydrologic regions of Dan Auerbach's draft low-flow memo and
# set them beside his regional low-flow measures, to scope whether an analysis
# of flow effects on angling opportunity is plausible. Descriptive only.
#
# Inputs
#   analysis/pst/outputs/05_assembly/pst_fw_effort_long.csv   (PST assembly)
#   CRC area polygons: CRC.gdb.zip from evanbooher/crc_mapping, else the live
#     WDFW CatchRecordCardArea service
#   HUC4 polygons: USGS Watershed Boundary Dataset service (cached locally)
#   local/low_flow_annual_ballpark.csv  - Dan's annual regional-reference
#     values READ BY EYE from his draft figures (approximate)
#   local/low_flow_decade_change.csv    - Dan's Table 1 decade changes
#
# The local/ folder is git-ignored: Dan's draft numbers stay out of the repo
# until he shares them beyond the agency.
#
# Output
#   crc_area_huc4.csv - catch area -> HUC4 lookup from the spatial join
# ==============================================================================

suppressMessages({
  library(tidyverse)
  library(sf)
  library(here)
  library(glue)
  library(knitr)
})
sf_use_s2(FALSE)

DIR       <- here("analysis", "flow_opportunity_scope")
LOCAL     <- file.path(DIR, "local")
dir.create(LOCAL, showWarnings = FALSE)
EFFORT    <- here("analysis", "pst", "outputs", "05_assembly", "pst_fw_effort_long.csv")
# CRC polygons: set CRC_GDB to the zip in your crc_mapping clone, or drop the
# zip into local/. Without either, the live WDFW service is queried.
CRC_GDB   <- Sys.getenv("CRC_GDB", file.path(LOCAL, "CRC.gdb.zip"))
CRC_SERVICE <- paste0("https://geodataservices.wdfw.wa.gov/arcgis/rest/services/",
                      "FP_Projects/CatchRecordCardArea/MapServer/1/query?",
                      "where=1%3D1&outFields=*&f=geojson&outSR=2927")
HUC4_CACHE <- file.path(LOCAL, "huc4_wa.geojson")

REGIONS <- tibble(
  huc4   = c("1701", "1702", "1703", "1706", "1707", "1708", "1710", "1711"),
  region = c("Kootenai-Pend Oreille-Spokane", "Upper Columbia", "Yakima", "Lower Snake",
             "Middle Columbia", "Lower Columbia", "Oregon-Washington Coastal", "Puget Sound"))
REGION_LEVELS <- REGIONS$region
MIN_SHARE <- 0.8     # a catch area with less of its area than this in one HUC4 is flagged
LOW_FLOW_MONTHS <- 8:10  # Aug-Oct: late-summer low flows overlapping fall salmon openings

theme_set(theme_classic(base_size = 10) +
            theme(text = element_text(colour = "black"),
                  strip.background = element_blank(),
                  strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
                  plot.title.position = "plot",
                  plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0)))
TIER_COLS <- c("Creel (P1)" = "#2a78d6", "CRC-based (P2/P3)" = "#eb6834")
```

## Purpose and status

Dan Auerbach's draft memo (internal; please don't share beyond WDFW) estimates
lower, more frequent and longer low flows across eight HUC4 hydrologic regions,
comparing 2016–2025 with 2006–2015. He asked whether creel data could show
effects on angling **opportunity**. This prototype puts our 2022–2025 salmon
angler-trip estimates into his regions and sets them beside his measures. It is
for scoping only: it tests whether the pieces fit together and shows what a real
analysis would need. It does not estimate a flow effect.

::: {.callout-important}
## Lower Columbia is missing the mainstem Columbia
The Lower Columbia region here holds tributary trips only. It is missing **all
mainstem Columbia River salmon angler trips**, which are estimated outside this
pipeline and would need to be supplied separately to complete the region.
Lower Columbia totals below understate the region's salmon angling effort.
:::

**About the flow values.** The annual values (2022–2025) were read by eye from
the draft memo's Figures 2–4 and are approximate: about ±0.05 for occurrence and
±10–15% for magnitude and span. The decade changes are copied from the memo's
Table 1. All are regional-reference estimates, meaning the modelled regional
pattern with individual gage effects removed, not the average of the gages.

## 1. Catch areas to HUC4 regions

```{r spatial-join}
crc <- if (file.exists(CRC_GDB)) {
  st_read(CRC_GDB, quiet = TRUE)
} else {
  message("CRC.gdb.zip not found - querying the WDFW CatchRecordCardArea service")
  st_read(CRC_SERVICE, quiet = TRUE)
}
if (is.na(st_crs(crc))) st_crs(crc) <- 2927
crc <- crc |>
  rename_with(\(x) sub("^CatchRecordCode$", "catch_area_code", x)) |>
  mutate(catch_area_code = str_remove(as.character(catch_area_code), "\\.0+$")) |>
  st_transform(2927) |>
  st_make_valid()

if (!file.exists(HUC4_CACHE)) {
  wbd <- paste0("https://hydro.nationalmap.gov/arcgis/rest/services/wbd/MapServer/2/query?",
                "where=huc4+IN+(", paste0("%27", REGIONS$huc4, "%27", collapse = ","), ")",
                "&outFields=huc4,name&f=geojson&outSR=4326&maxAllowableOffset=0.001")
  download.file(wbd, HUC4_CACHE, mode = "wb", quiet = TRUE)
}
huc4 <- st_read(HUC4_CACHE, quiet = TRUE) |>
  rename_with(tolower) |>
  transmute(huc4 = as.character(huc4)) |>
  inner_join(REGIONS, by = "huc4") |>
  st_transform(2927) |>
  st_make_valid()

effort <- read_csv(EFFORT, show_col_types = FALSE,
                   col_types = cols(catch_area_code = "c", .default = col_guess())) |>
  mutate(catch_area_code = str_remove(catch_area_code, "\\.0+$"),
         year = as.integer(year), month = as.integer(month),
         tier_group = if_else(tier == "P1", "Creel (P1)", "CRC-based (P2/P3)"))
codes <- sort(unique(na.omit(effort$catch_area_code)))

# Share of each catch area's polygon area falling in each HUC4.
crc_codes <- crc |> filter(catch_area_code %in% codes) |>
  group_by(catch_area_code) |> summarise(.groups = "drop")
pieces <- st_intersection(crc_codes, huc4) |>
  mutate(a = as.numeric(st_area(geometry))) |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  group_by(catch_area_code) |>
  mutate(share = a / sum(a)) |>
  ungroup()
lookup <- pieces |>
  group_by(catch_area_code) |>
  arrange(desc(share), .by_group = TRUE) |>
  summarise(huc4 = first(huc4), region = first(region), share = first(share),
            other_huc4 = paste(huc4[-1], collapse = "|"), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(flag_split = share < MIN_SHARE)
not_in_layer <- setdiff(codes, crc_codes$catch_area_code)
outside      <- setdiff(crc_codes$catch_area_code, lookup$catch_area_code)
write_csv(lookup, file.path(DIR, "crc_area_huc4.csv"))
```

`r length(codes)` catch areas carry trip estimates. `r nrow(lookup)` were
assigned to a HUC4 by the largest share of their polygon area, and
`r sum(lookup$flag_split)` of those have less than `r MIN_SHARE * 100`% of
their area in one region (flagged; mostly mainstem Columbia reaches along region
boundaries). `r length(not_in_layer)` are missing from the catch-area layer and
`r length(outside)` fall outside the eight regions.

```{r map, fig.width = 9, fig.height = 6}
# Washington outline as a base layer: from the maps package if installed,
# else the Census TIGERweb states service (cached in local/). Skipped, with a
# note, if neither is available.
WA_CACHE <- file.path(LOCAL, "wa_state.geojson")
wa <- tryCatch({
  if (requireNamespace("maps", quietly = TRUE)) {
    st_as_sf(maps::map("state", "washington", plot = FALSE, fill = TRUE))
  } else {
    if (!file.exists(WA_CACHE))
      download.file(paste0("https://tigerweb.geo.census.gov/arcgis/rest/services/TIGERweb/",
                           "State_County/MapServer/0/query?where=STUSAB%3D%27WA%27",
                           "&outFields=NAME&f=geojson&outSR=4326"),
                    WA_CACHE, mode = "wb", quiet = TRUE)
    st_read(WA_CACHE, quiet = TRUE)
  }
}, error = function(e) { message("No Washington outline: ", conditionMessage(e)); NULL })
if (!is.null(wa)) wa <- wa |> st_set_crs(4326) |> st_transform(2927) |> st_make_valid()
# Map extent: Washington, so HUC4 parts in Oregon, Idaho and B.C. are cropped.
bb <- st_bbox(if (!is.null(wa)) wa else crc_codes)

# Design: the regions are named on the map, so they need no colour of their
# own - a neutral land fill with white region boundaries, and colour kept for
# the one thing the map is checking: catch areas (blue) and the ones split
# across regions (orange). Two slots of the dataviz reference palette,
# validated (CVD and normal-vision separation pass).
regions_wa <- if (!is.null(wa)) {
  st_intersection(huc4, st_union(wa)) |> st_collection_extract("POLYGON")
} else huc4
region_lab <- regions_wa |>
  group_by(region) |> summarise(.groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(geometry = st_point_on_surface(geometry),
         label = str_wrap(region, 14))
areas_map <- crc_codes |>
  inner_join(lookup, by = "catch_area_code") |>
  mutate(status = if_else(flag_split, "Split across regions (assigned to larger share)",
                          "Catch area with trip estimates"))
AREA_COLS <- c("Catch area with trip estimates" = "#2a78d6",
               "Split across regions (assigned to larger share)" = "#eb6834")

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = regions_wa, fill = "#efede8", colour = "white", linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_sf(data = areas_map, aes(fill = status, colour = status), linewidth = 0.25) +
  { if (!is.null(wa)) geom_sf(data = wa, fill = NA, colour = "grey35", linewidth = 0.4) } +
  geom_sf_label(data = region_lab, aes(label = label), size = 3, lineheight = 0.9,
                fontface = "bold", colour = "black", fill = alpha("white", 0.75),
                label.size = 0, label.padding = unit(0.15, "lines")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = AREA_COLS, name = NULL) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = AREA_COLS, name = NULL) +
  coord_sf(crs = 2927, xlim = bb[c("xmin", "xmax")], ylim = bb[c("ymin", "ymax")], expand = TRUE) +
  labs(title = "Catch areas with salmon trip estimates, by HUC4 hydrologic region",
       caption = paste("Regions are USGS HUC4 units clipped to Washington; white lines are region boundaries.",
                       "Mainstem Columbia areas along region boundaries are the main split cases.")) +
  theme_void(base_size = 10) +
  theme(text = element_text(colour = "black"),
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", margin = margin(b = 6)),
        plot.title.position = "plot",
        plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0, margin = margin(t = 6)),
        legend.position = "bottom", legend.justification = "left",
        plot.margin = margin(8, 8, 8, 8))
```

```{r split-table}
split_tbl <- lookup |> filter(flag_split) |>
  left_join(effort |> group_by(catch_area_code) |>
              summarise(trips_2022_25 = round(sum(angler_trips)), .groups = "drop"),
            by = "catch_area_code") |>
  arrange(desc(trips_2022_25)) |>
  transmute(`Catch area` = catch_area_code, `Assigned region` = region,
            `Share in it` = scales::percent(share, 1), `Other HUC4` = other_huc4,
            `Trips 2022-25` = scales::comma(trips_2022_25))
if (nrow(split_tbl) > 0) kable(split_tbl, caption = "Catch areas split across regions (assigned to the larger share)")
if (length(not_in_layer) > 0)
  cat("Catch areas with trips but no polygon in the layer:", paste(not_in_layer, collapse = ", "))
```

## 2. Salmon angler trips by region

```{r trips-by-region}
trips <- effort |>
  inner_join(lookup |> select(catch_area_code, huc4, region, flag_split), by = "catch_area_code") |>
  mutate(region = factor(region, REGION_LEVELS))
unassigned <- sum(effort$angler_trips, na.rm = TRUE) - sum(trips$angler_trips, na.rm = TRUE)

annual <- trips |>
  group_by(huc4, region, year, tier_group) |>
  summarise(trips = sum(angler_trips), .groups = "drop")

annual |>
  group_by(region, year) |>
  summarise(creel = sum(trips[tier_group == "Creel (P1)"]), trips = sum(trips), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(creel_share = creel / trips) |>
  mutate(cell = glue("{scales::comma(trips, 1)} ({scales::percent(creel_share, 1)})")) |>
  select(region, year, cell) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = year, values_from = cell) |>
  rename(Region = region) |>
  kable(caption = "Salmon angler trips by region and year (share from creel in brackets)")
```

`r scales::comma(unassigned, 1)` trips
(`r scales::percent(unassigned / sum(effort$angler_trips, na.rm = TRUE), 0.1)`) sit on catch
areas without a region (missing polygon, outside the eight regions, or no catch
area code) and are left out below. Lower Columbia also lacks all mainstem
Columbia River trips (see the note at the top).

```{r trips-fig, fig.width = 9, fig.height = 5}
ggplot(annual, aes(factor(year), trips, fill = tier_group)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7, colour = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  facet_wrap(~ region, ncol = 4, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = TIER_COLS, name = NULL) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_comma(), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Salmon angler trips",
       title = "Salmon angler trips by HUC4 region, 2022-2025",
       caption = str_wrap(paste(
         "Creel (P1) trips are design-based creel estimates or district totals. CRC-based trips are",
         "Catch Record Card harvest multiplied by a trips-per-fish ratio from creeled rivers, so their",
         "year-to-year change follows harvest; 2025 CRC-based trips include projected harvest."), 140)) +
  theme(legend.position = "top", legend.justification = "left")
```

## 3. When fishing happens relative to the low-flow season

```{r monthly, fig.width = 9, fig.height = 5}
monthly <- trips |>
  filter(!is.na(month)) |>
  group_by(region, month) |>
  summarise(trips = sum(angler_trips), .groups = "drop") |>
  group_by(region) |>
  mutate(share = trips / sum(trips)) |>
  ungroup()
lf_share <- monthly |> group_by(region) |>
  summarise(lf = sum(share[month %in% LOW_FLOW_MONTHS]), .groups = "drop")

ggplot(monthly, aes(factor(month.abb[month], month.abb), share)) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = min(LOW_FLOW_MONTHS) - 0.5, xmax = max(LOW_FLOW_MONTHS) + 0.5,
           ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, fill = "grey90") +
  geom_col(width = 0.7, fill = "#2a78d6") +
  geom_text(data = lf_share, aes(x = 1, y = Inf, label = glue("Aug-Oct: {scales::percent(lf, 1)}")),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, hjust = 0, vjust = 1.3, size = 3) +
  facet_wrap(~ region, ncol = 4) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = \(x) substr(x, 1, 1)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent(), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Share of 2022-2025 trips",
       title = "Monthly share of salmon angler trips, 2022-2025",
       caption = "Grey band: August-October, when late-summer low flows overlap fall salmon openings. Trips with no month are left out.")
```

## 4. Effort beside the decade change in low flows

```{r decade, fig.width = 9, fig.height = 4}
decade_path <- file.path(LOCAL, "low_flow_decade_change.csv")
annual_path <- file.path(LOCAL, "low_flow_annual_ballpark.csv")
if (!file.exists(decade_path) || !file.exists(annual_path))
  stop("Save low_flow_decade_change.csv and low_flow_annual_ballpark.csv in ", LOCAL)
decade <- read_csv(decade_path, show_col_types = FALSE, col_types = cols(huc4 = "c"))
flow_yr <- read_csv(annual_path, show_col_types = FALSE, col_types = cols(huc4 = "c"))

region_effort <- annual |>
  group_by(huc4, region) |>
  summarise(mean_trips = sum(trips) / n_distinct(year), .groups = "drop") |>
  left_join(lf_share, by = "region") |>
  left_join(decade |> select(huc4, occurrence_pp, span_days, magnitude_pct), by = "huc4")

region_effort |>
  pivot_longer(c(span_days, occurrence_pp, magnitude_pct), names_to = "measure") |>
  mutate(measure = recode(measure,
                          span_days = "Longest low-flow span (+ days)",
                          occurrence_pp = "Occurrence (+ percentage points)",
                          magnitude_pct = "Magnitude (% change)")) |>
  ggplot(aes(value, lf, size = mean_trips)) +
  geom_point(colour = "#2a78d6", alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_text(aes(label = region), size = 2.6, vjust = -1.2, check_overlap = TRUE) +
  facet_wrap(~ measure, scales = "free_x") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent(), expand = expansion(mult = 0.2)) +
  scale_size_area(max_size = 9, labels = scales::label_comma(), name = "Mean annual trips") +
  labs(x = "Decade change, 2016-2025 vs 2006-2015 (Dan's Table 1)",
       y = "Share of trips in Aug-Oct",
       title = "Regions with more late-summer fishing beside each region's change in low flows",
       caption = "Eight regions, no inference. Point size: mean annual salmon angler trips, 2022-2025.")
```

## 5. Year-to-year: trips against annual low-flow conditions

Within each region, each year's trips are shown relative to that region's
2022–2025 average (1 = average year), against the year's low-flow values.

```{r annual-compare, fig.width = 9, fig.height = 6}
yr <- annual |>
  group_by(huc4, region, year) |>
  summarise(all = sum(trips), creel = sum(trips[tier_group == "Creel (P1)"]), .groups = "drop") |>
  group_by(huc4) |>
  mutate(`All trips` = all / mean(all),
         `Creel trips only` = if (mean(creel) > 0) creel / mean(creel) else NA_real_) |>
  ungroup() |>
  left_join(flow_yr |> select(huc4, year, magnitude_cfs_wy, occurrence_prob_cy, span_days_cy),
            by = c("huc4", "year")) |>
  group_by(huc4) |>
  mutate(magnitude_index = magnitude_cfs_wy / mean(magnitude_cfs_wy)) |>
  ungroup()

yr |>
  pivot_longer(c(`All trips`, `Creel trips only`), names_to = "trips_basis", values_to = "trip_index") |>
  pivot_longer(c(span_days_cy, magnitude_index), names_to = "flow_measure", values_to = "flow_value") |>
  mutate(flow_measure = recode(flow_measure,
                               span_days_cy = "Longest low-flow span (days, calendar year)",
                               magnitude_index = "Low-flow magnitude (relative to region's 2022-25 mean)")) |>
  filter(!is.na(trip_index)) |>
  arrange(year) |>
  ggplot(aes(flow_value, trip_index, colour = factor(region, REGION_LEVELS))) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, colour = "grey60", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_path(aes(group = region), linewidth = 0.4, alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  facet_grid(trips_basis ~ flow_measure, scales = "free_x") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("#2a78d6", "#eb6834", "#1baf7a", "#eda100",
                                 "#e87ba4", "#008300", "#6250d6", "#e34948"), name = NULL) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Trips relative to region's 2022-2025 mean",
       title = "Annual salmon angler trips against annual low-flow conditions, 2022-2025",
       caption = str_wrap(paste(
         "Flow values read by eye from Dan's draft figures (approximate). Lines join a region's years in order.",
         "Four years per region, no inference. Puget Sound and Coastal trips in odd years include pink salmon runs."), 140)) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

## What this can and can't support

- **Four years against a decade-scale change.** Our trip estimates cover
  2022–2025, while Dan's result compares two decades. Section 4 can only set
  current effort beside past change, and Section 5 has four points per region.
- **Runs drive effort more than flow.** Odd-year pink salmon in Puget Sound,
  forecasts and in-season run size, and season-setting all move trips more than
  flow is likely to. Any flow signal would need these accounted for.
- **CRC-based trips follow harvest.** They are CRC harvest × a trips-per-fish
  ratio, so a flow effect on effort per fish (fish concentrated in low water, or
  anglers staying home) cannot show in them, though year-specific donor ratios
  carry some regional signal. Creel-only trips are shown separately for this
  reason.
- **Lower Columbia is incomplete.** Mainstem Columbia River salmon angler trips
  are not in these estimates and would need to be supplied separately; until
  then Lower Columbia effort is tributaries only and not comparable with the
  other regions' totals.
- **Calendar mismatch.** Magnitude is by water year (Oct–Sep); occurrence and
  span are by calendar year. A fall fishery responds to flows in the weeks
  around its opening, which annual values blur.
- **Opportunity is set by rules.** Emergency closures and hoot-owl restrictions
  for low flow or warm water are the most direct link to Dan's question, and we
  have no day-level record of them.

**Next steps if worth pursuing:**

1. Pull August–October flow measures at gages near creeled rivers (Dan's
   gage-level data or `dataRetrieval`) rather than annual regional values.
2. Use the 2010–2024 CRC harvest series by catch area and month for a
   decade-scale comparison (2010–2015 vs 2016–2024), recognising that harvest
   also tracks run size.
3. Use creel rivers with long records (e.g. Skagit, Cowlitz) for effort per fish
   against flow within a season.
4. Compile emergency closure and hoot-owl rule dates by river as a direct
   opportunity measure.

## Data downloads

The tables behind this report, embedded in the file. Dan's draft low-flow values
are not included; they stay with his memo.

```{r downloads, results = "asis"}
csv_link <- function(df, file, label) {
  txt <- readr::format_csv(df)
  cat(glue('- <a href="data:text/csv;charset=utf-8,{utils::URLencode(txt, reserved = TRUE)}" ',
           'download="{file}">{label}</a> ({nrow(df)} rows)\n\n'))
}
csv_link(lookup, "crc_area_huc4.csv",
         "Catch area to HUC4 lookup (largest-share region, share, other regions, split flag)")
csv_link(annual |> mutate(trips = round(trips, 1)), "trips_by_huc4_year_tier.csv",
         "Salmon angler trips by HUC4 region, year and estimate source")
csv_link(monthly |> mutate(trips = round(trips, 1), share = round(share, 4)), "trips_by_huc4_month.csv",
         "Salmon angler trips by HUC4 region and month, 2022-2025 combined")
csv_link(trips |> group_by(catch_area_code, huc4, region, year, tier_group) |>
           summarise(trips = round(sum(angler_trips), 1), .groups = "drop"),
         "trips_by_catch_area_year.csv", "Salmon angler trips by catch area and year, with region")
```
